label: Dubstep / Chillstep (Soft, Atmospheric)
tempo_line: Tempo as written 128-140 BPM, felt half-time 64-70 BPM
tempo_note: Tempo is written the sourced dubstep way: 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 (drumstep: about 172-174, felt 86-87). The official melodic dubstep cards say 171 for the same kind of music. Compare by ear before trusting either.
note: Studio-authored recipe, not an official Music 3 template, untested (nothing has been rendered from it yet).

cards.mood: Calm and wistful: the intro opens with a soft pad and piano, the verses float over a gentle half-time beat, and the chorus blooms with a warm sub and wide pads. A quiet bridge strips to piano and voice before a final, fuller chorus fades…
cards.vocal: Singer A (Female). The vocalist possesses a clear, breathy, airy soprano timbre with a soft, intimate lower register.
cards.palette: A soft piano plays slow, sparse minor chords through the verses and chorus, while a warm sine sub enters gently under the first chorus and stays to the end.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM

cards.mood: Gentle and hopeful: the track begins with a lone piano phrase and field-recording ambience, adds a soft sub and a rounded beat in the first section, opens into a warm, wide melodic bloom in the middle and ends on a single sustained chord.
cards.vocal: No lead singer. Faint, breathy, wordless vocal textures, like soft sustained pads, float in the background.
cards.palette: A solo piano plays a lyrical, sparse major-key melody with long sustain, supported by a warm sine sub that enters with the beat.
cards.tempo_line: written 128 BPM, felt half-time as 64 BPM

cards.mood: Introspective and tender: the verses sit on a soft beat and a deep sub, the chorus lifts with pads and a gentle bass swell, a stripped bridge leaves voice and piano, and the final chorus adds layered harmonies.
cards.vocal: Singer A (Male). The vocalist possesses a soft, warm baritone timbre with a calm, introspective quality.
cards.palette: A warm, rounded sub and a soft electric piano support the voice, with an airy plucked synth playing the melodic motif between the lines.
cards.tempo_line: written 140 BPM, felt half-time as 70 BPM
